items.question: What happens after I fill out the form?
items.answer: Gabe will reach out to set up a short intro call. We'll talk about your organization and what winning looks like for you this year.

items.question: Do I need a plan or a budget before we talk?
items.answer: No. Just bring your goals. Every engagement is custom. After the call, we build a plan and proposal around your goals for the year.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: Kingdom-minded businesses, and nonprofits too. We're based at the Atrium in Indianapolis and work with organizations across Indiana and beyond.
